description: Illustrative functional-entitlement API responses for strategic cashflow migration.

registration.status: Identity from supplied UAT samples; production registration is not confirmed.

notes: All 17 function actions for this role and subject match the supplied EMS2 export.
Responses contain only this role and subject; other roles, subjects and applications are omitted.
The Portal drawer is an excerpt containing tile 37; other tiles sharing this subject are omitted.
The signed permission JWT is a placeholder, not a valid token. The separate access JWT is returned in the Single-UI-Authorization response header.
portal-entitlements-map.json is the decoded and parsed entitlements claim. In the signed JWT, this map is serialized as a JSON string.
Data entitlements, policies, profiles and logical indicators are deliberately omitted from these functional examples. Omission does not mean the user has no data entitlements.
Whole-entity EMS3 conversion exists in the POC. Migrating only this subject while other RATAN subjects stay on EMS2 still requires the proposed tile routing and merge.
